MODULAR BETA 1 — PRIVATE TEST (MAC)

Thank you for testing Modular.

INSTALL THE VST3
1. Quit your DAW.
2. Copy "Modular Beta 1.vst3" into:
   ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/
3. Restart your DAW and rescan plug-ins if necessary.

STANDALONE VERSION
"Modular Beta 1.app" can be opened directly from Applications or another folder.
macOS may ask you to confirm the first launch because this is a private beta.

TESTING NOTES
- Load a WAV or AIFF sample, then play it through MIDI.
- Try the FX rack, close/reopen the plug-in window, and save/reopen a project.
- Texture Lab can run Granular, Orbit, and Random independently.

PLEASE REPORT
- DAW and macOS version
- What you were doing when an issue happened
- A screen recording or screenshot if possible
- Any sound glitches, excessive loudness, clicks, or crashes

Frameworks / Modular Beta 1
Private test build — not for resale or redistribution.
